answer: Each agent broadcasts a cipher-bound identity beacon whose key is tied to a licensed spectrum slot, so spoofed clones collide on the same channel. Neighbor cells cross-check received signal strength against a stored knoll of expected path-loss curves, flagging any node claiming a position its link budget cannot support. This drains the tide of free identities: an attacker must buy and physically site radios matching each claimed footprint, capping sybils at real estate cost.
